key_rationale: With core inflation at 3.60% significantly below the headline CPI of 5.10%, the current repo rate of 6.50% is becoming excessively restrictive in real terms, threatening to stifle the 6.80% GVA growth momentum. I believe the stance should be shifted to neutral to reflect that the policy rate is now sufficiently high to anchor inflation expectations without imposing an unnecessary drag on the economy.
